tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: All tracked AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini Code Assist, Antigravity, Windsurf) with every plan: price, stated usage limits, window, models, source URL and checked date. Undisclosed values say "not disclosed".

tools.name: get_tool_plans
tools.description: Plans and limits for one tool. tool_id one of: claude-code, openai-codex, cursor, github-copilot, gemini-cli, antigravity, windsurf.

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated change log of AI coding plan and usage-limit changes, newest first, each with a vendor source.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Plans priced at or under a monthly USD budget, highest price first (same logic as the PlanLimits budget picker).

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Given the plans you own, how much of each is used, and the task type, returns which plan to use now, a fallback, when each limit resets (from vendor-stated windows), a rationale, a suggested weekly rotation, and source links. Same logic as https://planlimits.app/router/. Unknowns are labeled estimat

tools.name: can_afford_task
tools.description: For agents deciding whether to start a task: given the plans you own, how much of each is used, optionally the plan you are on now, and the task size, returns verdict go | wait | switch, which plan to use, reasons and reset windows. Reuses the route_task logic. Task size is a labeled heuristic (vend

tools.name: pick_plan
tools.description: Answers 4 questions and returns the cheapest fitting plan with reasons, up to 3 alternatives and source links (same logic as https://planlimits.app/picker/). interface: terminal | ide | any; budget_usd: monthly USD; usage: light | daily | heavy (usage rule is a labeled rule of thumb); who: individua

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Live operational status and open incidents from official vendor status pages (Claude/Anthropic, OpenAI/Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Google Cloud Gemini/Vertex AI, Windsurf). Outages only: it does not detect throttling or per-account limits. provider one of: anthropic, openai, cursor, github, googl

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_plans · Private data: can_afford_task · Public sink: can_afford_task · Destructive: can_afford_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_plans · Private data: can_afford_task · Public sink: can_afford_task · Destructive: can_afford_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
